name: Falcon Staked USDf
oneLiner: sUSDf is Falcon's USDf savings share, accruing strategy rewards and redeemable for USDf subject to admin restrictions and a configurable cooldown.
collateral: USDf held in the Ethereum sUSDf ERC-4626 savings vault; upstream backing and issuer risk remain with usdf-falcon
pegMechanism: Deposit USDf to mint sUSDf shares; USDf rewards increase the share-to-USDf exchange rate as they vest. Direct share redemption has cooldownDuration() = 0 at Ethereum block 26107704 on 2026-10-02, but administrators can introduce a cooldown of up to 90 days and restrict deposit or redemption accounts. Platform redemption separately requires approved onboarding and remains subject to Falcon's terms.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum deployment 0xc8cf6d7991f15525488b2a83df53468d682ba4b0 is a current ERC-4626 operational share claim on USDf. At Ethereum block 26107704 (2026-10-02T22:44:11Z), asset() is 0xfa2b947eec368f42195f24f36d2af29f7c24cec2; decimals() is 18, totalSupply() is 56876949.092047125101 shares, totalAssets() is 64669136.889719046652 USDf, and balanceOf(vault) is 64670233.223213575780 USDf. convertToAssets(1e18) and previewRedeem(1e18) return 1.137000804756 USDf. Local vault conservation, custody and recovery differ from the parent's synthetic-delta-neutral hedge book, so protocol-position is an intentional local archetype override; upstream economic risks remain inherited through the 100% wrapper dependency.
